# Event seating-chart builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/seating-chart/

Assign named guests to tables with chosen capacities, move assignments and export a printable table-by-table seating plan.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Seat twelve guests across three tables and move a guest to a different table without duplicating them.

## Limits and checks

This is a manual arrangement helper. Relationship preferences, venue access and evacuation requirements are not automatically assessed.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
